orders.title: Orders
items: Please use the 'Order Here' page to begin the ordering process. MISHMAKERY, LLC will contact you for further details to book the order.

Whenever possible, communication via direct messaging is preferred (text message, Instagram, Messenger, email, etc.). If communicating via phone calls, MISHMAKERY will send notes of the discussion to your preferred method of text communication.

Orders will only be booked when a deposit of 50% of the final balance is paid. Full payment is required at least 10 days prior to the due date for non-wedding orders & 1 month prior to the due date for wedding orders.
When an order is placed less than 10 days prior to the due date, the order must be paid in full to be booked, and all order details must be finalized at the time of booking.

safety.title: Safety
items: Many custom orders with complex decorations, such as tiered cakes, require structural support in the form of plastic/wooden straws or dowels. Some decorations may be secured with toothpicks, skewers, or pins.
MISHMAKERY, LLC will communicate all such structural supports at the time of order pickup or delivery and will advise you on which components of the order should be removed prior to consumption.

MISHMAKERY, LLC assumes no liability for injuries or damage sustained due to improper handling of orders, including but not limited to cake-smashing, eating non-edible decorations, not removing structural supports, dropping the order, etc.

dietary_restrictions.title: Dietary Restrictions
items: All allergies and intolerances must be communicated to MISHMAKERY, LLC in writing at the time of order placement.

While MISHMAKERY, LLC will do everything possible to ensure orders are safe for consumption based on allergies and intolerances, there is always a risk of cross-contamination. By placing the order and/or paying the deposit, you understand that all orders are consumed at your own risk and that MISHMAKERY, LLC is not liable for any health issues arising from the handling or consumption of an order.
There are certain allergies, intolerances, and dietary restrictions that MISHMAKERY, LLC cannot accommodate. These will be communicated when you inform MISHMAKERY, LLC about such allergies.

pickup_delivery.title: Pickup/Delivery
items: Baked items are fragile and require extra care when transporting. If picking up the order, you should ensure that there is a level surface on which to place the order during transport. It is recommended that you drive extremely carefully, take turns slowly, stop gradually, and leave plenty of space in front of the vehicle.
All orders must be picked up on the agreed upon date and time, unless otherwise communicated.

For large orders, particularly tiered or tall cakes, delivery by MISHMAKERY, LLC is recommended. Delivery is offered starting at $60.00 within the Louisville area & an additional $2.50 per mile outside of the Louisville area.
MISHMAKERY, LLC assumes no responsibility for any items after pickup and after MISHMAKERY, LLC leaves the premises for a delivery.

refunds_cancellations.title: Refunds/Cancellation
items: Deposits may not be refundable if the order is canceled within 10 days of the due date.
Any refunds are granted solely at the discretion of MISHMAKERY, LLC on a case by case basis.
MISHMAKERY reserves the right to cancel a booked order if an order cannot be fulfilled due to personal emergencies, sickness, etc.
